gbifID.description: Unique numeric identifier for each Sesamum indicum occurrence record.

datasetKey.description: Unique identifier for the dataset source.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URLs identifying individual Sesamum indicum records.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification for all recorded Sesamum indicum occurrences.

phylum.description: Phylum classification for Sesamum indicum specimens, consistently recorded as Tracheophyta.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the Sesamum indicum specimens, consistently recorded as Magnoliopsida.

order.description: Taxonomic order classification for Sesamum indicum occurrences.

family.description: The family classification for all Sesamum indicum records is Pedaliaceae.

genus.description: Genus name for Sesamum indicum occurrences.

species.description: The scientific name of the recorded Sesamum indicum species.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet of Sesamum indicum, such as malabaricum or indicum.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the occurrence, specifically species or subspecies.

scientificName.description: Taxonomic classification of Sesamum indicum specimens, including subspecies designations.

verbatimScientificName.description: Original scientific name provided by the data source, including subspecies designations.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: The column is entirely empty, containing no recorded data.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for species occurrence records.

locality.description: The locality field is entirely empty, containing no recorded spatial information for any occurrence.

stateProvince.description: Geographic state or province of occurrence records.

occurrenceStatus.description: The occurrence status of Sesamum indicum specimens, consistently recorded as present.

individualCount.description: All values are null, indicating no recorded individual counts for these occurrences.

publishingOrgKey.description: Unique identifier for the publishing organization.

decimalLatitude.description: Decimal latitude coordinates in degrees, ranging from -35.88 to 53.21.

decimalLongitude.description: Decimal longitude coordinates in degrees, ranging from -118.29 to 145.33.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty radius in meters for species occurrence records.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision is not recorded for any occurrence records.

elevation.description: Elevation data is entirely missing from the occurrence records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy is not recorded for any occurrence records.

depth.description: All values are missing, indicating no depth data is recorded for these occurrences.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy is not recorded for any occurrence records.

eventDate.description: Event date and time of species observation in ISO 8601 format.

day.description: Day of the month for the Sesamum indicum occurrence record, ranging from 1 to 31.

month.description: Month of occurrence recorded as an integer from 1 to 12.

year.description: Integer year of species occurrence, ranging from 2002 to 2026.

taxonKey.description: Unique alphanumeric identifiers for taxonomic classification of Sesamum indicum occurrences.

speciesKey.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for Sesamum indicum species occurrences.

basisOfRecord.description: The method of observation for each Sesamum indicum occurrence record.

institutionCode.description: The institution code identifies the source of the occurrence record as iNaturalist.

collectionCode.description: The collection code is consistently recorded as Observations for all entries.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier for each Sesamum indicum occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: A fully null field with no recorded values.

identifiedBy.description: Identifier of the person who identified the Sesamum indicum specimen.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when the Sesamum indicum specimen was identified.

license.description: The license field specifies the Creative Commons or public domain license applied to the occurrence

rightsHolder.description: Identifier of the individual or organization holding the rights to the occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded the Sesamum indicum occurrence data.

typeStatus.description: A placeholder column with no recorded data for type status.

establishmentMeans.description: All values are missing, providing no establishment method information.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the last automated interpretation for each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type of the occurrence record, primarily still images.

issue.description: Semicolon-separated flags indicating data quality issues such as rounded coordinates, derived continents, or missing taxon
